nodes.label: No loop guard republisher rule
nodes.rationale: A republisher subscribes to one exact source and channel of a device created earlier, so republish chains are finite and cannot close into a cycle.

nodes.label: For block
nodes.rationale: Max turns is a hard budget so a loop that would not end (step 0, wrong direction) cannot stall the pass.

nodes.label: Bank-alternating atomic commit
nodes.rationale: A save fills the spare bank and the project record write is the commit point, so the stored project is never touched by a failed or aborted save.

nodes.label: Project run and boot autostart
nodes.rationale: RUN nests three levels (project record, chunk list, chunk) so SYS_ACTIONS_MAX_DEPTH must be >= 3; the VM start is the program's own last EXEC frame, the firmware does not know the VM here.

nodes.label: Shared device block engine (vm_block_device)
nodes.rationale: One table per contract over one engine; a _Static_assert per row ties fields to the contract arg struct. Operation kinds CHANGE / EDGE / READ with optional idle op.

nodes.label: VM_BLOCK_TYPE_DEFINE registration and load-time verify
nodes.rationale: Shape checked once at load by vm_block_verify so bodies never re-check; component is WHOLE_ARCHIVE so nothing else references a block.

nodes.label: ACTION block (run stored action)
nodes.rationale: Action is queued and run on the router task, not inside the pass, because an action may stop, rewind or unload the program and a long replay would outlast the block watchdog.

nodes.label: EXPR block (float RPN formula)
nodes.rationale: Formula verified once at load (ops, wired inputs, stack depth) so only values are checked at run time.

nodes.label: Device block call semantics (setting / action / reading)
nodes.community_name: Device block call semantics  / On event block
nodes.norm_label: device block call semantics (setting / action / reading)
nodes.rationale: Setting sent on first enabled pass and on change; action once per rising enable; reading every enabled pass. Device refuses what it cannot do, nothing is clamped.

nodes.label: Latch block
nodes.community_name: Device block call semantics  / On event block
nodes.rationale: Turns a one-pass pulse into a held level, to remember that something happened.

nodes.label: On event block
nodes.community_name: Device block call semantics  / On event block
nodes.rationale: Events are not consumed and live one pass; a disabled block misses them like a physical edge.

nodes.label: Every (periodic tick) block
nodes.community_name: Device block call semantics  / On event block
nodes.rationale: Deadline advances by exactly one period so the rate does not drift; missed ticks are dropped, not replayed.

nodes.label: Timer block (IEC 61131-3)
nodes.community_name: Device block call semantics  / On event block
nodes.rationale: A disabled timer is not skipped: it runs with a false signal so off-delay and pulse finish on their own.
